'''Aklan Urshant''' was the son of [[Andus Urshant]] and [[Zoam Urshant]]. He was eight years old when his family evacuated [[Demophon]] before its [[Demophon (star)|sun]] went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. During this time he wanted to be a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] when he grew up.<ref name="TC" />
